name: Maddox Drive-In Lean Bison Burger or Roasted Turkey Burger
brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House & Drive-In (Perry / Brigham City, UT)
whyItWorks: Maddox's famous Drive-In griddles freshly ground lean ranch bison and roasted Utah turkey burgers on house-baked soft white buns—offering far less saturated grease than standard fast-food burgers on the drive between Salt Lake and Logan.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bison Burger or Turkey Burger on a house white bun with aged cheddar only (hold raw onion, lettuce, pickles, and heavy fry sauce).
watchOuts: If ordering Maddox's famous homemade Root Beer, let the carbonation settle or sip slowly so gas bubbles don't cause bloating
